conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Namaste, main Sanjay Rawat. Mera debit card ka annual fee kyun laga?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Sanjay ji, main aapke card details check karta hoon. Kya aap card number bata sakte hain?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Maine dekha, aapke card ka annual fee standard charges ka hissa hai. Lekin, agar aap minimum transactions karte hain, toh main fee waive karne ki request daal sakta hoon.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Theek hai, main request daal deta hoon. 5 din mein fee reverse ho jayega. Koi aur sawal?
